{
  "steps":{
    "0":"START",
    "1":"Microwave-Microwave on high for 90 seconds until the egg is cooked through",
    "2":"add-add bread pieces to the egg mixture in the mug, pressing the bread down into the egg",
    "3":"stir-stir the mug",
    "4":"melt-In a large mug, melt 1 tablespoon of softened butter in the microwave for about 30 seconds",
    "5":"Sprinkle-Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon over the egg",
    "6":"cut-cut the contents on plate, and serve",
    "7":"Put-Put the mug's contents on a plate",
    "8":"Roll-Roll the butter around in the mug to coat it",
    "9":"Cut or tear-Cut or tear 1 slices of bread into bite-size pieces",
    "10":"Add-Add 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract to the mug",
    "11":"whisk-In the mug, whisk one egg with a fork until well blended",
    "12":"END"
  },
